name: Travel
description: Cheapest-window flight search: give a rough departure/return date and it fans a background search across every nearby date combination to find the cheapest fare, instead of you checking one date pair at a time. Direct Google Flights API access via the fli library — no scraping, no browser.

skills.description: Cheapest-date-window flight search through this app's aw-travel MCP server — how to kick off a background search job and poll/wait for results.

apps.reason: This app ships a static mcp.json (the 'travel' server) that MCP Gateway discovers and merges; without the gateway no agent can reach its tools.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace loads mcp-gateway before this app so the gateway can scan travel/mcp.json.
